evaluator: Model visual judgment from original rendered screenshots and instrumented interaction, not a human usability study.
scope: Visual clarity of Robot setup, Operate, Record and Replay; preserve supported behavior.
previous_score_note: The earlier 95/100 report emphasized functional workflow. Its visual assessment was rejected by the user; this separate rubric prioritizes rendered visual quality and text density.

dimensions.evidence: Selected source is a compact segment; primary task actions are blue, Stop is red. Sidebar and auxiliary actions are quieter.
dimensions.deduction: Replay still exposes several specialized controls in its toolbar.

dimensions.evidence: Default setup has no long guide paragraphs. Help and diagnostics are disclosures. Nano capability limits remain a single visible line.
dimensions.deduction: Physical rig configuration and calibration still contain technical terminology.

dimensions.evidence: Simulation uses the full model area; real setup has a narrower default inspector. Recording actions occupy a single 32 px row. Camera framing adapts to panel geometry.
dimensions.deduction: At minimum width the physical rig form occupies substantial vertical space; camera aspect ratios leave unused margins.

dimensions.evidence: PingFang retained; compact flat controls have centered labels and explicit focus/disabled states. Essential controls fit both sizes and themes.
dimensions.deduction: Some icon-only panel controls lack hover explanations.

dimensions.evidence: Actual-input simulation record/save/replay, real-device error handling, help, panel maximize/restore and an extra native replay window passed.
dimensions.deduction: A complete keyboard-only journey was not repeated in this visual pass.

hard_gates.criterion: Default setup has no repeated instructional paragraphs.
A visually distinct primary action is present when applicable.
Simulation has no permanent explanatory side panel.
Real robot capability limits and actionable errors remain visible.
Help and diagnostics can be expanded and dismissed.
Primary controls fit 1024x768 and 1440x900 in both themes.
Simulation record/save/replay and flexible layouts continue to work.

findings: Tall header and oversized navigation treatment
Low contrast appearance label in light theme
Narrow model view could crop after source/theme changes
Text disclosures, compact actions and larger work area verified
Camera fit and zoom continuity repaired
Final original user window opened and captured

checks.check: Start simulation reaches Operate with 3 live cameras
Setup preserves recording and blocks simulation shutdown
Stop waits for every sensor frame
Saved replay advances independently of the live source
Discard removes only the new take and preserves saved data
Invalid profile gives an actionable error
Missing hardware is blocked before calibration
Physical capture is gated by calibration
Nano capabilities explicitly exclude arm calibration and cameras
Nano mock base remains connected in Operate
Leaving physical controls stops the base driver

checks: Help opens and closes without leaving setup
Advanced source and layout reset are available under More
Control help expands the full mapping while L1 release-to-stop stays visible by default
Simulation hides the unneeded inspector without overwriting the saved real robot layout
Replay camera maximization restores the original panel layout
Additional native replay window opens and closes while preserving the main dataset

dataset_audit.intrinsics: nominal simulation values, preserved with provenance

validation.final_case_bounds: All essential controls checked in both real Nano and editable arm forms at 1024x768 and 1440x900, light and dark.

limitations: This is a model-authored visual review, not independent user research.
Actual physical robot calibration was not performed. Existing real Nano base-only capability limits are unchanged.
The simulation dataset remains 5 fps in simulation time, not 30 fps real-time capture.
Review screenshots, telemetry and captured datasets are local artifacts kept outside tracked source. Only sanitized receipts and hashes are stored here.
